# Public Social Account Analyzer
> Agent Skill & CLI toolkit for auditing public creator accounts across Bilibili, Douyin, Weibo & Xiaohongshu with immutable audit artifacts.

Auditable public collection and deterministic offline analysis for AI Agents. Source availability and release acceptance are separate; P0/P1 are priorities, not production certifications.

## Documentation
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/README.md): Platform capability matrix, current limitations, and quickstart commands.
- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/skill/SKILL.md): Actual CLI routing, evidence rules, and known execution/security boundaries.
- [Usage Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/USAGE.md): Detailed CLI options; check current script help and Skill boundaries when older prose conflicts.
- [Testing & Quality Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/TESTING.md): Test procedures and fixtures, not proof that a particular revision passed.
- [Implementation and Acceptance Summary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/llms-full.txt): Summary of implemented contracts and unclosed gates; not a concatenation of all reference documents.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/ROADMAP.md): Runtime fixes, reproducible verification, and external acceptance gates.
- [2026-11-15 Repository Audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/docs/acceptance/repository-audit-2026-11-15.md): Fixed-baseline findings, offline reproduction, and checks not executed.

## Optional
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/docs/architecture/STRUCTURE.md): Pipeline data flow, collector isolation, and evidence persistence.
